plan: With a private value of $20, my goal is to maximize potential profit. Since this is a first-price sealed bid auction with payment at second-highest price, I want to bid strategically. My optimal strategy is to bid close to, but slightly below my true value. I'll bid $19.9 to capture almost the full potential gain while leaving a small margin of safety in case of close competing bids.

With a private value of $17, my goal is to maximize potential profit. Since values are independently drawn and this is a single round, I'll use a strategic bidding approach. I want to bid high enough to have a good chance of winning, but not so high that I eliminate my potential profit margin. Given the $0-$20 range, I'll bid slightly below my true value to create room for profit if I win. A bid around $15 seems strategic.

With a private value of $13, my goal is to maximize potential profit. Since the auction pays the second-highest bid, I want to bid strategically. A bid just above my value could work if others bid lower. Given the random nature and single round, I'll bid slightly above my value to increase winning chances while maintaining potential profit margin.
